players.product: Xiaomi Group consumer ecosystem (human / car / home) expanding AI; public and enterprise cloud services buyer from Kingsoft Cloud

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 operations (interim report): smartphone shipments 65.0 million units, down 22.9% from 84.2 million, at a record ASP of RMB1,329.7 per unit (+16.5%); smartphone revenue RMB86.4 billion. Smart EV deliveries 185,055 vehicles, up 17.7% from 157,171, with fewer SU7 deliveries after sales of the first-generation Xiaomi SU7 Series were discontinued in Q1 2026; smart EV revenue RMB42.9 billion (+10.9%) at an ASP of RMB231,848 (-5.8%); the smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment had an H1 loss from operations of RMB5.7 billion at a 19.6% gross margin. H1 capital expenditures approximately RMB6.9 billion, including RMB3.9 billion in the smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment. The company cites CPCA for Chinese Mainland passenger vehicle retail volume down 20% year-over-year in H1.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 shipments 65.0 million (-22.9%); H1 deliveries 185,055 (+17.7%); segment H1 operating loss RMB5.7 billion; H1 capex RMB6.9 billion

quarterly_data.signal: EV launches (interim report): the Xiaomi YU7 GT launched on May 21, 2026 from RMB389,900, the first model developed with deep engagement of the Xiaomi EV Europe R&D and Design Center, which Xiaomi established in Munich, Germany in early 2025; the Xiaomi YU7 Standard launched the same day with a CLTC range of 643km from RMB233,500.
quarterly_data.figure: YU7 GT from RMB389,900; YU7 Standard from RMB233,500, CLTC range 643km

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration and related parties (interim report): revenue from every single external customer was below 10% of total revenue in Q2 and H1 2026 (2025: Customer A 11.7% and 11.6%). H1 2026 purchases of goods and services from associates of the group were RMB7,092,093 thousand (H1 2025: RMB21,806,280 thousand), with trade payables to associates of RMB6,244,556 thousand at June 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: no customer above 10% (2025: Customer A 11.7% / 11.6%); H1 purchases from associates RMB7,092,093 thousand
